title: A batch gate whose probe hits a hanging test file still settles
description: Runs the real gate over ports whose clock the case controls and a real test file that never finishes: the verified-commit probe stops that file at the merge trial's five-minute per-file timeout, counts it as failed there, and the gate keeps the batch with the check as a known red instead of timing out (GY-3620).

steps.name: a hanging probe file stops at the per-file timeout and the gate settles
